purpose: Follow-up audit for the adversarial-review changes of October 3, 2026. Run scripts/audit_adversarial_review.py; it is read-only.

rules.load: A skill or m_get_skill tool call for adversarial-review, or a user-invoked skill.invoked event from a slash command.
rules.dedup: One load per tool call ID or slash-command event ID across all sessions, so forked session copies count once.
rules.window: Starts at the first successful load whose content hash equals the current repository SKILL.md body hash. A later content change restarts the window.
rules.subagent_share: Successful loads with an agentId, divided by all successful loads.
rules.duplicate_turn: A main-thread user turn with more than one successful load.
rules.disclosure: The last main assistant message in the turn has an 'Execution path:' line and a 'Premortem:' line.
rules.freshness: The first main assistant message after the load starts with 'Adversarial review | Updated: '.
rules.exclusions: Sessions that built, verified, or reviewed this change, so that test loads do not count.

prior.measured: 2026-10-03, local logs only, same rules, all history
